confusions: Neither the Garden nor the inbox is reachable by 'los search' (search dag --type garden -> []; inbox likewise in S04), so duplicate detection against them needs ls/cat of the directories.

garden.seed.create only creates; there is no capability to append to an existing seed, and none to retire an inbox item that has already been processed (work/inbox/20260816-drf-paper-link.md stays although the paper is registered and noted).
expected_revisions for a new Garden seed must name a request-scoped artifact 'garden-request:<idempotency_key>' at revision 0; not documented, but the INVALID_REQUEST error named it exactly.
INVALID_REQUEST exits 2 while UNCONFIRMED (S04) exited 0 — inconsistent exit codes for refused writes.
corrective_steps: Added the artifact id named by the error to expected_revisions and resubmitted with a new request_id.

Refused writes exit 2 (INVALID_REQUEST) or 0 (UNCONFIRMED in S04); callers cannot rely on the exit code.
